SUBJECTS_firespit_with_bezzul.lead_html: What this is: RM_FireSpit is the ranged attack of the bezzul, a snail with an iron-sulphide shell (second row). The bezzul lobs a burning glob of its own spit at a target up to 15 cells away: 5 shots, each a small flame hit. Nobody orders it; the bezzul uses it on its own when hunting or fighting. It has two pictures: the glob in flight (drawn at 2 cells) and the ability button icon. Judge both: does the flying glob read as burning spit, and does the icon read at button size?
